Mana is one of the Character Stats for Player Characters.

## Contents

- 1 Overview

- 1.1 Mana debt

- 1.2 Limit and Regeneration

- 2 UI

## Overview[]

Mana is a regenerating resource that players can use to cast Skills. Most skills have a mana cost that must be paid either when an ability is used upon activation, or during channeling. As long as a character has any mana, they may use abilities freely. In some cases, minions may also use player skills.

### Mana debt[]

When an ability uses more mana than what the player has, the character goes into negative mana. Until the player reaches positive mana again, they may not use any ability that has a cost.

### Limit and Regeneration[]

The mana pool can be increased through Affix Shards, building Attunement and allocating various Passives and Skill augmentations. Mana is regenerated at a rate of 8 mana / second, which can be improved with Mana Regeneration Shards.

## UI[]

The available mana for the active player is displayed right to the skill bar.

The Mana globe displays the current and maximum Mana of the character. If the player has Mana, the globe is blue. If the player has negative Mana, the globe is light pink and their character emits a dazzling purple effect. The maximum mana is also displayed on the character stats screen.
